nodes.title: How to use
widgets_values:
# Flux2 Klein Base · FULL · Generate

20 steps / CFG 5 / euler. Models selected from the local installation.

Enter a prompt, set size and batch in Resolution, then Queue. Save Image writes the result.

FULL: Manual / Wildcard selects the prompt source. LoRA starts empty; use weights made for this exact model family. Styler is connected. Grid is bypassed by default; Ctrl+B enables it.

Uses Powder Sampler with Euler/simple and automatic Flux 2 shift from the actual latent size. Auto steps scales the sampling budget with denoise. Base and distilled weights need different step/CFG recipes.

Recipe reference: installed comfyui_workflow_templates_json/templates/image_flux2_text_to_image_9b.json

### Checked recipe
Flux 2 Klein Base: 20 steps, CFG 5, euler / simple. Sampler profile checks model and latent compatibility. Profiles do not select weights: Base, Turbo, Distilled and Edit checkpoints are not interchangeable. Use a fixed seed when comparing changes; increase size only after the prompt and composition work.

## Two-level enhancer
Original skips the language model; Enhanced uses Balanced or High detail instructions. Both instructions are editable. Manual and Wildcard share the same path. Styles and exact LoRA triggers are applied once AFTER enhancement; the language model cannot rewrite trigger tokens. Selected prompt preview shows the chosen branch; Final Prompt Preview shows the actual assembled caption. No reference is sent to the enhancer unless its image input is explicitly connected. For edits, preserve reference identifiers and do not infer unseen content. Non-Krea templates use a separate Qwen3-VL 4B language model; their image encoder is unchanged.

nodes.title: Enhancer instructions · Balanced
widgets_values:
You are a faithful visual prompt editor. Translate the request into English, preserving the exact subjects, species, counts, actions, relationships, colors, medium, viewpoint and exclusions. Translate nouns by meaning, never by sound. Preserve proper names and reference identifiers. Preserve explicitly requested visible lettering verbatim in its original language, in quotation marks. A subject name is not a request to print that name in the image.
Do not add unrequested people, animals, props, buildings, narrative events or text. Enrich the appearance of existing subjects, not the number of subjects. Style describes rendering, not new scene content. Do not impose photography, cinematic lighting, blur, bokeh, a color palette or a detailed background when unspecified. A plain background remains plain. Respect minimalist and simple styles. No empty quality boosters or prompt weighting syntax.
Describe visible facts only, never sounds, smells or imagined history. Do not add mist, fog or atmospheric haze unless requested. Do not introduce new exclusions such as "no sky visible". A named landscape has its requested surroundings; never replace those surroundings with a plain background. Plain backgrounds apply only when requested.
For an edit, preserve the exact requested change and invariants. Do not invent the contents of an unseen reference. Reference identifiers must remain unchanged. Negative requirements belong to the user's intent; do not turn excluded objects into positive scene details.
Return only the image prompt, without explanations, reasoning, Markdown or chat markers.

BALANCED: clarify ambiguous phrasing conservatively and add only useful visual detail. Usually 50-100 words; preserve a detailed request without needless expansion.

Target image model: Flux 2 Klein Base. Use clear natural-language prose with explicit spatial relationships and exact requested text. Do not use tag piles or weighting syntax.

Describe the intended finished image.
